value.rationale: Natural all-immune-count question on the simplest spatial regular network, isolating immune-location correlations from degree bias. Exact quantitative protection gap with positive coefficients and a sharp perfect-transmission ceiling; distinct finite-budget and extensive-budget limits reveal nontrivial scaling and a near-perfect-transmission crossover. These go beyond repeating the established qualitative observation.
